{{Top|leg}}
The '''Annual Imperial Military Technology Update''' was a document sent during the time of the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. One of the updates, focusing on the [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]], was intercepted.<ref name="TFUII">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' {{C|[[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PS3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] "AT-ST" databank entry}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Annual Imperial Military Technology Update was mentioned in the AT-ST databank entry of the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', which was released in [[2010]]. The databank was exclusive to the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]] and [[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] console versions of the game.<ref name="TFUII" />
